words.sense: Withdrawn and ill-tempered, typically because of a particular hurt or resentment.
misconceptions: Any serious-looking person is sulking about something.

words.sense: Marked by a lasting disposition toward dark, somber moods.
misconceptions: A temporary offended silence proves a permanent temperament.

semantic_axes.description: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.

edges.boundary_rule: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.

misconceptions.M1: Any serious-looking person is sulking about something.
misconceptions.M2: A temporary offended silence proves a permanent temperament.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Elias after team selection?

beats.text: After being left off the team, Elias sat apart, frowned, and refused to answer friendly questions.
beats.reason: His mood follows a specific disappointment and turns others away.

beats.text: He remained silent while the rest of the players packed their bags.
beats.reason: The continued silence belongs to the same disappointed mood.

chains.feedback_short: Elias turns away after being excluded; his silence reflects that specific disappointment.
chains.feedback_deep: Sullen describes resentful withdrawal after an upsetting event. Saturnine suggests a broad, habitual somber disposition, which a single episode does not establish.
chains.contrast_rule: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

hints.attention: Look at what happened immediately before his mood changed.
hints.axis: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.
hints.contrast: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Miriam’s usual manner?

beats.text: For years, Miriam has rarely laughed or shown excitement, even at the happiest family gatherings.
beats.decisive_clue: years of somber conduct across happy occasions
beats.reason: This is a lasting way of being, not one offended reaction.

beats.text: At her own birthday dinner, she gave the same quiet, unsmiling thanks after receiving the gifts she wanted.
beats.decisive_clue: the same long-standing reserve persists during pleasure
beats.reason: The later occasion reinforces a stable temperament.

chains.feedback_short: Miriam’s somber manner persists even when she receives something she wants.
chains.feedback_deep: Saturnine is about someone’s characteristic gloom. Sullen usually implies ill-tempered withdrawal connected with resentment or disappointment.
chains.contrast_rule: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

hints.attention: Consider the pattern over years, not one evening.
hints.axis: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.
hints.contrast: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Nia’s reaction to her grade?

beats.text: After seeing the mark she disliked, Nia folded her arms, stared at the floor, and snapped at friends who approached.
beats.decisive_clue: resentful reaction to a disappointing mark
beats.reason: Her withdrawal and irritation have a clear trigger.

beats.text: The grade was printed on blue paper rather than white.
beats.decisive_clue: resentment over the mark remains regardless of paper color
beats.reason: The paper does not explain the bad-tempered response.

chains.feedback_short: Nia’s irritated withdrawal follows the grade; the paper color has no bearing.
chains.feedback_deep: Sullen is a mood of withdrawn resentment. The trigger and her response matter; incidental presentation details do not establish a lifelong gloomy character.
chains.contrast_rule: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

hints.attention: Find the cause of her withdrawal.
hints.axis: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.
hints.contrast: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Kenji’s general manner?

beats.text: For as long as anyone remembers, Kenji has greeted neighbors with an unsmiling face and a low, flat voice.
beats.reason: No particular recent slight is offered as the cause.

beats.text: He responds in the same subdued way even on the day his long-awaited holiday begins.
beats.decisive_clue: habitual gravity persists during a welcome event
beats.reason: A happy occasion does not change the established pattern.

chains.feedback_short: Kenji’s serious manner is long-standing, even when something pleasant happens.
chains.feedback_deep: Saturnine characterizes an enduring gloomy temperament. Sullen would more strongly suggest sulking or offended silence caused by a particular event.
chains.contrast_rule: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

hints.attention: Decide whether this is a mood or a disposition.
hints.axis: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.
hints.contrast: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Ada’s response at home?

beats.text: After her roommates borrowed her food without asking, Ada stayed in her room and answered invitations with short, irritated replies.
beats.reason: The behavior reflects resentment about the borrowed food.

beats.text: She still checked every message they sent, but replied only with a curt “fine.”
beats.decisive_clue: resentful refusal of warm interaction continues
beats.reason: The terse reply develops the immediate grievance, not a permanent nature.

chains.feedback_short: Ada’s curt replies reflect a recent grievance rather than a lifelong disposition.
chains.feedback_deep: Sullen means brooding, bad-tempered withdrawal. Saturnine instead describes a person characteristically inclined to gloom in many situations.
chains.contrast_rule: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

hints.attention: Focus on the grievance behind the curt replies.
hints.axis: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.
hints.contrast: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

chains.frame: Which adjective best describes Yusuf’s usual demeanor?

beats.text: For many years, Yusuf has rarely smiled and has spoken in a low, heavy tone at work, on trips, and during family games.
beats.decisive_clue: similar grave manner across settings over many years
beats.reason: His mood appears characteristic rather than reactive.

beats.text: He is polite and helps visitors whenever they ask.
beats.decisive_clue: habitual somber appearance despite considerate behavior
beats.reason: Kindness does not rule out a grave temperament.

chains.feedback_short: Yusuf can be consistently somber while still treating others kindly.
chains.feedback_deep: Saturnine need not imply hostility; it describes enduring gloom. Sullen more directly suggests resentful, ill-tempered withdrawal from others.
chains.contrast_rule: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.

hints.attention: Distinguish temperament from how politely he treats people.
hints.axis: Sullen is a resentful or sulky response to something; saturnine is a more enduring somber disposition.
hints.contrast: Sullen broods over a slight; saturnine carries a lasting shadow.
